## 4. Gap Analysis

- **Critical Gap:** No software development or service-building experience whatsoever — all engineering work is in quality assurance
- **Critical Gap:** No cloud provider experience (an explicit requirement)
- **Significant Gap:** Java and REST experience are entirely test-side, not production development
- **Significant Gap:** No evidence of architecture participation, system design, or owning a service
- **Significant Gap:** Zero exposure to preferred tech stack (Kafka, Docker/K8s, Terraform, observability tools)
- **Minor Positive:** Proximity to Plano, TX (Garland) addresses hybrid requirement

---

## 5. Risk Detection

- **Title mismatch risk:** Self-identifies as a "quality engineer transitioning to development" — the role requires a demonstrated senior software engineer, not someone in transition
- **Seniority risk:** 5 years experience is in QA, not engineering; would likely function at a junior dev level
- **Ramp-up risk:** Would require extensive mentoring — the opposite of the mentoring responsibility this role requires
- **Cloud risk:** Missing an explicitly required qualification with no adjacent experience

---

## 6. Overall Threshold Assessment

- **Required qualifications met:** ~2–3 of 7 (below minimum threshold of ~6/7)
- **Competency composite:** 1.7/5 (threshold typically ≥ 3.5/5 for senior roles)
- **Keyword match:** 21% (threshold typically ≥ 60% for advancement)
- **Disqualifying gaps:** Cloud experience (hard requirement); backend development experience (core role function)

The candidate has a solid QA background and shows relevant adjacent skills, but the role is a **Senior Software Engineer — not a Senior QA Engineer**. The experience gap is structural, not superficial.
